label: Diff
description: Read-only tracked Git changes with unified patches.

folder.description: Repository directory; defaults to session directory.

mode.description: auto: committed branch/latest commit; workingDirectory: base to tracked working contents; branch: merge base of baseRef and HEAD to tracked working contents, including local changes; sinceCommit: selected commit to tracked working contents, including later commits and local changes; refs: direct snapshots; mergeBase: common ancestor to destination commit.

targetRef.description: Destination revision; unused for workingDirectory, branch and sinceCommit modes.
